info.title: Studojo Contact Enrichment API
info.description:
Resolve a person to their verified contact details.

Send a **LinkedIn URL** (highest match rate), or a **name + company**, and get back a verified **work email**, **personal email**, and **personal mobile**. Every email is validated (MX + SMTP) and every phone is checked for line type, so you receive a real personal mobile, never a switchboard or office landline. Any field we cannot verify is left out rather than guessed.

**Billing.** You are charged one credit only when a verified contact is returned. Misses cost nothing. The same identity requested again within 30 days is served from cache (`cached: true`) and is not re-charged.

**Latency.** A single enrich resolves synchronously, usually in 5 to 15 seconds. For more than a handful of people, use the bulk endpoint and poll.

**Rate limit.** 60 requests per minute per key on single enrich. Every response carries `X-RateLimit-Limit`, `X-RateLimit-Remaining` and `X-RateLimit-Reset`; a 429 also sends `Retry-After`.

post.description:
Resolve one person to their verified work email, personal email and personal mobile.

**Identify the person** one of two ways (mutually exclusive):
1. `linkedin_url` - a LinkedIn profile URL. Highest match rate; use this whenever you have it.
2. `first_name` + `last_name` (or a single `name`) **and** `company` (or `domain`). Lower match rate than a URL, but works when you only have a name.

**What you get back.** `emails.work`, `emails.personal` and a `phone` object. The `phone` is only ever a verified **personal mobile** - office landlines, switchboards, toll-free and VOIP numbers are rejected, and `phone` is `null` if none can be verified (the emails are still returned). `found` lists which fields resolved and `confidence` scores the result 0 to 1.

**Billing.** One credit on a verified contact; a `not_found` result or a cache hit (`cached: true`) is free. Idempotent by identity for 30 days, so retries are safe and never double-billed.

200.description: The enrichment result. `status` is `ok` when at least one field resolved, or `not_found` (empty fields, `credits_used: 0`) when nothing could be verified.

X-RateLimit-Remaining.description: Requests left in the current window.

X-RateLimit-Reset.description: Unix time when the window resets.

post.description:
Enrich up to **500** people in one call. Returns a `job_id` immediately (HTTP 202); the batch resolves on its own and you poll `GET /jobs/{job_id}` to collect results as each person completes - you never hold a connection open.

Each entry in `profiles` uses the same identity rules as single enrich (a `linkedin_url`, or `first_name` + `last_name` + `company`/`domain`). Entries are de-duplicated by identity (normalized LinkedIn URL, else name + company), so the same person sent twice is resolved once. Billing is per verified result, identical to single enrich.

get.description: Poll a bulk job. While it runs, `status` is `processing`; once the batch is done it becomes `completed` and `results` holds one enrichment result per person (same shape as single enrich). Poll every few seconds. Jobs are scoped to the key that created them.

200.description: Job status and results so far.

404.description: No job with that id for this key.

bearerAuth.description:
Your API key as a bearer token. Create and manage keys at studojo.com/apidocs.

Header: `Authorization: Bearer sk_live_...`

EnrichRequest.description: Identify the person by a LinkedIn URL, or by name + company/domain. Provide a `linkedin_url`, OR `first_name` + `last_name` (or `name`) together with `company` (or `domain`).

linkedin_url.description: LinkedIn profile URL. Highest match rate.

first_name.description: First name. Use with last_name + company/domain.

name.description: Full name, an alternative to first_name + last_name (it is split for you).

domain.description: Company domain, an alternative to company name.

fields.description: Restrict what is resolved. Defaults to both when omitted.

profiles.description: Up to 500 people. Each uses the same fields as a single enrich.

fields.description: Applied to every profile. Defaults to both.

phone.description: A verified personal mobile, or null.

credits_used.description: Credits charged for this result. 0 on a miss or a cache hit.

cached.description: Present and true when served from the 30-day cache (not re-charged).

linkedin_url.description: Resolved even when you searched by name.

Phone.description: Only a verified personal mobile is ever returned. Office / landline / toll-free / VOIP numbers are rejected.

count.description: How many unique people were queued.

results.description: One result per person (only when completed).

OutOfCredits.description: Monthly quota exhausted. Top up or raise your limit.

BadRequest.description: Body was not JSON, or no valid identity (need a linkedin_url, or first + last name with a company/domain), or over the 500-profile bulk limit.

example.message: Provide a linkedin_url, or first_name + last_name + company.

RateLimited.description: Over 60 requests/minute. Back off and retry after Retry-After seconds.

InternalError.description: Enrichment failed unexpectedly. Safe to retry.

EngineUnavailable.description: The enrichment engine is not reachable right now. Retry shortly.
